instruction: Enable real-time collaborative editing mode in VS Code and share the current file with another user.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because enabling collaborative editing in VS Code requires the Live Share extension and involves authentication, network setup, and sharing links with other users - none of which can be fully automated or verified in the isolated desktop environment.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - collaborative editing in VS Code requires Live Share extension, authentication, network connectivity, and interaction with external users
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the semantically correct choice for tasks that cannot be automated or verified in an isolated desktop environment
No getter can verify authentication state, network sharing sessions, or that another user received access
The task fundamentally requires external dependencies (network services, other users) that are impossible to verify programmatically in the test environment
